prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1021; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather keep my name off this recording, if that's all right. You already have it on the claim file.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was driving on a multi-lane road in Pearland, Texas, heading toward the freeway. Traffic was moderate, and I was in the right lane.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I was changing lanes to the left because I needed to get over for my exit. I checked my mirror, I saw nothing, and I signaled and started moving over.

Q: Did you notice the other vehicle at any point?

A: Not until it was right beside me. It came up in my blind spot and scraped along my passenger side as I was merging. I heard the grinding sound and felt the car jerk toward the median.

Q: Did you stop after the contact?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder as soon as I could. The other driver stopped a little ahead of me and walked back. We exchanged information, and the police were called.

Q: How are you feeling physically since the accident?

A: My lower back is pretty sore. It tightened up that same evening, and I've had trouble sitting for long periods. I went to a clinic the next day and they told me it's a strain.

Q: Have you received any treatment since then?

A: I've been doing physical therapy twice a week and taking over-the-counter pain relievers. My doctor said to expect a few weeks of recovery.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was following the rules when I changed lanes. I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
